en: If you weigh 100 pounds on Earth, you would only weigh about 16.5 pounds on the Moon because its gravity is one-sixth as strong.
Light travels at 299,792 kilometers per second, allowing it to circle the Earth's equator about 7.5 times in just one single second.
Sound travels through water at about 1,500 meters per second, which is more than four times faster than it travels through the air.
A single bolt of lightning can heat the surrounding air to 50,000 degrees Fahrenheit, making it five times hotter than the surface of the Sun.
Tungsten has the highest melting point of all metals, requiring a temperature of 3,422 degrees Celsius to change from a solid to a liquid.
One gram of fat contains about 9 kilocalories of chemical energy, which is more than double the 4 kilocalories found in one gram of carbohydrates.
A small neodymium magnet can lift up to 1,000 times its own weight in iron objects due to its powerful magnetic pull.
A single movable pulley reduces the effort force needed to lift a heavy box by exactly 50 percent, though you must pull twice as much rope.
A hovercraft reduces surface friction so effectively that it can glide over both land and water at speeds exceeding 60 miles per hour.
The Concorde jet could fly at Mach 2, meaning it traveled at twice the speed of sound, or about 1,350 miles per hour.
A wheelchair ramp with a 1:12 slope ratio means you must travel 12 meters horizontally to achieve a vertical rise of exactly 1 meter.
When a 5-kilogram bowling ball strikes the pins at 8 meters per second, it transfers its kinetic energy to create over 100 decibels of sound.
